topic: Joke edit claiming Real Madrid's 2026-27 kits outclass Barcelona's; cycles through player photos in kits and Barca's new fire-pattern third kit
hero: Barcelona and Real Madrid players and kits (mixed unidentified players)
hero_role: subjects of the joke / supporting visuals
hook: Player in navy jacket with French flag, caption 'REAL' (one-word captions)
subtitle_style: One-word-at-a-time white bold italic caps with black outline, centred mid-frame (REAL / SEASON / IS / ARE / BARCA / ICONIC ...)
reaction_overlays: none; every word flips on a new photo cut
transition_summary: Hard cuts every ~2 s synced to words; roughly 5 cuts per 10 s

reuse_segments.what: Player promo photos and kit reveals (yellow away, black fire third kit)
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: official kit photos are brand property; recreate with generated kit imagery or own mock-ups
